breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The original prompt contained conflicting instructions for the numerical method, specifying both 'Explicit forward Euler' and a detailed 'Strang splitting' method. The ground truth resolves this by removing the incorrect 'Explicit forward Euler' instruction. The agent failed to fix this, instead incorrectly combining the two conflicting methods into the phrase 'Use explicit forward Euler time integration with Strang splitting', thereby repeating the user's error.
